Updates `tokio` from 1.52.3 to 1.53.0
- [Release notes](https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio/releases)

commit.message:
feat(webfont-generator): add async regeneration (#317)

- add async Rust and N-API regeneration APIs that return replacement results
- move Vite watch regeneration off the Node.js event loop
- preserve incremental and render caches across async result generations
- safely drain in-flight watcher rebuilds during shutdown
- document async ownership, recovery, and cancellation behavior
- add cross-platform tests and sync-versus-async benchmarks

Perf: Move regeneration state instead of cloning glyph caches, making unchanged incremental rebuilds 2-3x faster with negligible async overhead.

commit.message:
perf(webfont-generator): cut SVG transient allocations by 64% (#344)

Format rounded SVG coordinates directly into the destination buffer,
eliminating one temporary `String` allocation per coordinate while
preserving byte-identical output and rounding semantics.

In the 600-glyph SVG allocation profile:
- transient heap allocations decreased 63.8%
- transient heap bytes decreased 7.7%
- 16-byte short-string allocations decreased 86.1%

commit.message:
perf(webfont-generator): reduce WOFF2 transient allocations (#349)

Move the prepared transform stream into Brotli compression and preallocate the WOFF2 directory and stream buffers from known sizes.

Pin internal encoder output at qualities 0-11 for 1, 100, 300, and 600 glyphs to guard byte-identical output.

commit.message:
perf(webfont-generator): preallocate SVG font output (#357)

Reserve the SVG font buffer from known header, metadata, glyph, path, and
ligature lengths before serialization.

An exact 600-glyph probe cuts allocated bytes from 983,105 to 558,225
(-43.2%), removes 11 growth calls, and reduces spare output capacity from
22.3% to 2.8%. End-to-end timing shows no reproducible regression.

Preserve byte-identical SVG fixtures.

commit.message:
perf(webfont-generator): share processed SVG paths (#362)

* perf(webfont-generator): share loaded SVG contents

Store retained SVG source contents in Arc<str> so defensive regeneration snapshots share unchanged payloads instead of deep-cloning them.

* perf(webfont-generator): share processed SVG paths

Store processed path data in Arc<str> so cached glyphs and prepared generations share immutable path payloads instead of deep-cloning them.

commit.message:
perf(webfont-generator): share compiled TTF glyphs (#364)

Share cached compiled glyphs with Arc and retain used cache entries so incremental TTF rebuilds avoid deep-cloning outline contours.

commit.message:
perf(webfont-generator): defer cached SVG path clones (#365)

carry cached SVG geometry through incremental planning without cloning path vectors:

- reduces warm SVG preparation allocation by 73-78% at 100-600 glyphs
- reduces 600-glyph warm peak allocation by 84.5% and allocation calls by 59.6%
- reduces SVG-only content-edit allocation by 9-10% and allocation calls by 15-17%
- improves warm SVG preparation latency by 13-20% in alternating runs
- removes 718 KB and 1,797 allocation calls from a 600-glyph all-format edit
- preserves exact output, cache counts, rollback behavior, and real-edit performance

perf(webfont-generator): reuse structured path hashes (#369)

perf(webfont-generator): disable unused usvg features (#398)

disable unused `usvg` default features: remove SVG text, system-font, SVGZ, and writer dependencies from the lockfile, thereby reducing the measured stripped NAPI library from 5.7 MiB to 3.9 MiB
